summary.headline: Sobha FY26 real estate sales hit a record INR8,136 crore (+~30%), with Q4 EBITDA of INR194 crore and FY27 sales growth guided at a similar ~30%.
summary.overview: FY26 was a record year: real estate sales of INR8,136 crore at an average realisation of INR14,675 per sq ft (up 9.4% from INR13,412), and 3,188 homes (5.4 million sq ft) delivered, up about 19%. Q4 revenue recognition improved after occupancy certificates delayed in Q3 were received, with Q4 total income of INR2,030 crore, EBITDA of INR194 crore and PAT of INR92 crore. Net operating cash flow was INR1,637 crore for FY26 (up 39.4%) and the company moved to a net cash position of about INR800 crore. Management expects margins to improve through FY27, with projects nearing completion guided at 24-26% margins against a 30%+ EBITDA margin on the overall unrecognised revenue of INR18,647 crore. Some FY26 launches slipped, and the Rivana (Greater Noida) launch and the Crescent (Gurgaon) launch in April were the main new-launch data points.

segments.name: Bangalore
segments.commentary: Record annual sales of about INR4,500 crore, with both new launches and sustenance sales contributing.

segments.name: NCR (Gurgaon, Greater Noida)
segments.commentary: Record annual sales of about INR2,450 crore, helped by the Greater Noida expansion; Bangalore and NCR together made up about 85% of sales.

segments.name: Kerala
segments.commentary: Steady at about INR800 crore of sales in FY26.

segments.name: Other regions
segments.commentary: About INR400 crore of sales in FY26.

segments.name: Real estate deliveries
segments.commentary: 1,087 homes delivered in Q4 and 3,188 homes (5.4 million sq ft) for FY26, up about 19%.

segments.name: Non-real estate (manufacturing, contracting, retail)
segments.commentary: Management says these performed steadily; collections of INR732 crore in FY26 and INR183 crore in Q4, with an expectation of similar run rate and better profitability.

guidance_outlook: FY27 sales growth expected at a similar rate to FY26 (~30%), with pricing stable and growth coming mainly from volume.
FY27 net operating cash flow target close to INR2,000 crore.
Launches of about 10 million sq ft planned in FY27 across Bangalore, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Thrissur and Pune; a 20.67 million sq ft pipeline over the next 6-8 quarters.
Margins expected to improve through FY27, higher toward Q3 and Q4, as projects nearing completion are recognised at 24-26% margins versus 30%+ EBITDA margin on total unrecognised revenue.
FY27 sales mix guided at roughly 45-50% from sustenance and 50-55% from new launches.
Business development spend of about INR1,100-1,200 crore expected in FY27, with pending land payments cleared in H1; targets a pipeline of at least 10 million sq ft a year.
Projected marginal cash flow of INR9,560 crore from completed and ongoing projects, and INR8,699 crore from forthcoming projects.
capex_capacity: Hoskote (Bangalore) residential project: about 5.3 million sq ft, GDV about INR7,000 crore; Phase 1 expected to launch in Q1 FY27 after RERA; at least half of Phase 1 to be released initially, with ~INR3,500 crore potentially launching depending on demand.

Rivana (Greater Noida): about 2.5 million sq ft, 1,384 units; Phase 1 of 684 units launched in late March 2026, with about 25% sold; execution started. Crescent (Gurgaon) Phase 1 launched in April 2026, about 50% sold, about INR1,100 crore.
Q2 FY27 launches planned in Calicut and Thrissur (Kerala); a Bangalore row-house project was cancelled and is being relaunched as apartments toward year-end.
About 2 million to 2.5 million sq ft of rental/commercial space planned in the next few years on land in Hoskote and Gurgaon; Hoskote Phase 2 and 3 to include commercial.
Tentative Pune and Chennai launches toward year-end; Hyderabad second project awaiting approvals, targeted this year.
demand_pricing: Pricing described as stable for 3-4 quarters, with NCR and Bangalore both stabilising; management expects growth mainly from volume.
Management says leading indicators (inquiries, site visits) are stable and there is no big slowdown from AI concerns for the sub-INR3 crore ticket band, though demand is not at the 2021-23 peak.
Launch pricing for FY27 assumed at about INR15,000 per sq ft; FY27 GDV from the ~10 million sq ft launches estimated at about INR15,000 crore.

Management flagged commodity and material price increases from the geopolitical situation; the margin impact is not yet quantified and will be reviewed in 3-6 months. Escalation clauses have not yet been exceeded.
Labour shortage was temporary, caused by state elections in four states.
Kerala inquiries improved slightly, given that much of its demand comes from the Middle East.

qa_highlights.question: Why are gross margins and EBITDA still below historical guidance, and when will they expand?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said margins will rise as ongoing projects complete at end of Q2 and Q3 FY27, with Q3 and Q4 expected to be far better, in line with the projected EBITDA margin.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Hoskote project size, GDV and approval status?
qa_highlights.answer: About 5.3 million sq ft of residential space with a GDV of about INR7,000 crore; RERA expected in Q1 FY27 and the launch is at an advanced stage.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the Row House project converted to apartments?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said this is a better use of the land, with higher ticket sizes, higher realisation and margins, and it will add to sales value.

qa_highlights.question: How are Rivana and Crescent performing and why was Rivana weaker?
qa_highlights.answer: Rivana sold about 25% of its launched inventory (~INR500 crore) and Crescent about 50% (~INR1,100 crore). Management attributed the gap to the timing of the Rivana launch in late March amid uncertainty, rather than to demand, and said sustenance sales are good.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY27 sales split between sustenance and new launches, and what is the GDV of the FY27 launches?
qa_highlights.answer: Sustenance is expected at 45-50% and new launches at 50-55%. About 10 million sq ft of launches is roughly INR15,000 crore GDV, and with about INR1,200-1,300 crore of unreleased inventory the total is about INR27,000-28,000 crore.

qa_highlights.question: How much cost inflation is expected and can it be passed on?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said cost inflation is event-led and its duration is unknown; the impact will be assessed over 3-6 months, and price increases depend on demand-supply, so it is in a wait-and-watch mode.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for rental and annuity income?
qa_highlights.answer: Management sees about 2-2.5 million sq ft of rental space on land already held in Hoskote and Gurgaon, with a decision on a separate rental vertical expected to be visible within a couple of quarters.

risks_watch: Launch slippage: some FY26 launches were delayed, and FY27 relies on about 10 million sq ft of launches, including Hoskote (INR7,000 crore GDV) whose Phase 1 needs RERA in Q1.
Margin recovery depends on project completions in Q2-Q3 FY27 and on absorbing commodity and material cost increases from the geopolitical situation.
Rivana sustenance pace after its ~25% launch sell-through; Phase 2 timing depends on demand.
Bangalore FSI change remains unresolved in the courts; management has not given a timeline.
Business development: Hyderabad and Mumbai have few current land parcels, with only two small Mumbai deals (about INR2,000 crore GDV) targeted this year.
Demand sensitivity to AI-related IT/ITeS job concerns and the macro environment in Bangalore.
summary.management_tone: Confident on volume, cash generation and margin recovery, with a clear multi-quarter timeline. Cautious and non-committal on input-cost inflation, pricing power and the FSI change, saying they will wait and watch. Management deflected the question on the sales of the Rivana and Crescent launches by attributing the weaker Rivana result to launch timing.
key_quotes: FY ‘26 has been an exceptional year for the company.
Our real estate sales reached an all-time high of INR8,136 crores, with strong and consistent average quarterly run rate of approximately INR2,000 crores.
And hence, we expect significant improvement in our P&L even in FY ‘27 with improving margins over the quarters and probably a little bit higher towards the end of Q3 and Q4.
We are aiming in FY ‘27 net cash -- net operating cash flow close to INR2,000 crores.

growth.why: Management guides FY27 sales growth of ~30% (similar to FY26), driven by volume with stable pricing, backed by ~10 million sq ft of launches (Hoskote Phase 1 in Q1 FY27, Rivana and Crescent already launched) and 24-26% margins on near-term completions; the brief gives no quarterly growth figures, and the 20.67 million sq ft pipeline and Kerala/Pune/Chennai launches are only partly specified.

rows.label: Margin expansion

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: About 10 million sq ft of launches planned in FY27 (Hoskote Phase 1 in Q1 FY27 after RERA, Kerala launches in Q2 FY27, Pune and Chennai toward year-end) against 20.67 million sq ft pipeline over 6-8 quarters, with FY26 deliveries of 3,188 homes (5.4 million sq ft) up about 19%.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management guides FY27 sales growth of about 30%, similar to FY26's INR8,136 crore, with pricing stable and growth from volume; FY27 launch GDV of about INR15,000 crore from ~10 million sq ft and sustenance at 45-50% of sales.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Business development spend of INR1,100-1,200 crore guided for FY27 and at least 10 million sq ft annual pipeline target, plus 2-2.5 million sq ft rental/commercial build-out in Hoskote and Gurgaon with a rental-vertical decision expected within a couple of quarters; no utilisation metric is given, so this is a land and pipeline spend rather than a plant capex call.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management is guiding FY27 sales growth of about 30% with stable pricing and says it is in wait-and-watch mode on cost inflation, so no upgrade is signalled before the 3-6 month cost review.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Hoskote Phase 1 depends on RERA in Q1 FY27, FY27 relies on about 10 million sq ft of launches, Rivana sold only about 25% (~INR500 crore) of launched inventory, and commodity inflation impact is not yet quantified; Bangalore FSI change is unresolved in courts.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Hoskote Phase 1 (5.3 million sq ft, GDV ~INR7,000 crore) in Q1 FY27, Calicut and Thrissur in Q2 FY27, Bangalore row-house project being relaunched as apartments toward year-end, and Pune and Chennai tentative toward year-end.

rows.label: Unrecognised revenue of INR18,647 crore supports margin and revenue visibility
rows.why: Unrecognised real estate revenue of INR18,647 crore at 31 Mar 2026 is already sold, with Q4 FY26 revenue recognition lifted after delayed occupancy certificates were received.

rows.why: Gross debt INR1,002 crore against cash INR1,802 crore at 31 Mar 2026, and FY26 net operating cash flow of INR1,637 crore (up 39.4%) with FY27 target close to INR2,000 crore.
